contract.intent: Run the requirement grilling step for building Ann: convert the vague goal into a PRD (or open-questions) artifact that gates the implementation children.
acceptanceCriteria: PRD draft artifact exists at tree/artifacts/ann-prd.md covering what/why, scope, success definition, product-level acceptance criteria
Blocking open questions surfaced with defaults (Q1 runtime, Q2 provider, Q3 storage, Q4 UI) per §8 human-interaction policy
Initial implementation branches (slices) identified in the PRD
Artifact gate: node must not spawn children until Q1-Q4 are answered and the PRD is final

openQuestions.question: Runtime/language for the implementation?
openQuestions.reason: Affects every slice; a fresh agent would get it wrong without an answer
openQuestions.defaultIfUnanswered: Node.js + TypeScript (original skeleton; mature agent/LLM ecosystem)

openQuestions.question: Model provider to start with?
openQuestions.reason: Design §16 is adapter-based, but the first adapter must be chosen
openQuestions.defaultIfUnanswered: Adapter-first; first adapter = whatever provider is configured locally (OpenAI-compatible)

openQuestions.question: Storage backend for the tree + branch checkpoints?
openQuestions.reason: Design §15/§21.5 require durable checkpoints; choice shapes the core API
openQuestions.defaultIfUnanswered: SQLite (better-sqlite3) for tree/index + JSON artifact files on disk

openQuestions.question: UI form factor for v1?
openQuestions.reason: §19 defers multi-UI; one surface must be picked for the MVP
openQuestions.defaultIfUnanswered: CLI + tree artifacts on disk (tree view + step cards + full plan renders)

unverifiedAcceptanceCriteria: PRD covers what/why, scope, success definition, product ACs

execution.contextPacket: Path: n01-goal (done) → grilling. Goal: build Ann (tree-of-steps planning system). Produce PRD draft + surface blocking questions. Do not spawn children yet (artifact gate).

quality.validationStatus: partial (PRD draft produced; open questions unresolved)
